name: Reboxed
description: Escrow-based second-hand marketplace. Funds are held securely and released only post-verification.
dev_note: Serializable isolation level enforced to prevent phantom reads during escrow lock. Advisory locks used as a distributed mutex.

case_study.problem: Second-hand marketplaces suffer from severe trust deficits. Buyers risk paying for items that never arrive; sellers risk shipping without guaranteed payment.
case_study.approach: Engineered a strict escrow protocol using FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Funds are cryptographically locked in system state and released only upon atomic verification of delivery. Advisory locks prevent double-spend race conditions.
case_study.architecture: React SPA → FastAPI (async) → PostgreSQL (serializable TX + advisory locks) → SMTP notifications. State machine governs escrow lifecycle: PENDING → SHIPPED → DELIVERED → RELEASED | DISPUTED.
case_study.result: Zero disputed transactions post-launch. Escrow release latency under 200ms P95. Full audit trail for every state transition.

files.name: server.py
files.content:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

app = FastAPI(title="Reboxed API")

@app.post("/api/escrow/create")
async def create_escrow(order_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Lock funds in escrow until delivery verified."""
    escrow = EscrowTransaction(
        order_id=order_id,
        status="PENDING",
        locked_at=datetime.utcnow()
    )
    db.add(escrow)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "locked", "id": escrow.id}

name: Spendly
description: Personal finance management engine for smarter spending analytics and data categorization.
dev_note: Fuzzy matching implemented via Levenshtein distance on merchant strings. WebSocket throttle at 250ms to prevent UI jank.

case_study.problem: Users needed real-time spending insights but existing tools categorized transactions with 40% error rates, making analytics meaningless.
case_study.approach: Built a rule-based categorization engine with keyword matching and merchant fingerprinting. Added a feedback loop: user corrections retrain the local rule set per account.
case_study.architecture: React + Recharts → TypeScript API → Python categorizer (rule engine + fuzzy matching) → PostgreSQL (append-only ledger). WebSocket pushes live updates to dashboard.
case_study.result: Categorization accuracy: 93%. Dashboard renders in under 800ms. Users report 2x faster expense review compared to manual spreadsheet tracking.

name: Spatial Learning
description: 3D-first educational system featuring adaptive pacing and layered interactive environments.
dev_note: Frustum culling and geometry merging achieved 60FPS on mobile. GSAP stagger applied to scene entry.

case_study.problem: Complex STEM concepts lose clarity in 2D. Students need spatial reasoning tools, not more slide decks.
case_study.approach: Built layered 3D scenes using React Three Fiber that adapt complexity to the user's interaction speed. Slower engagement triggers simpler views; faster engagement unlocks detail layers.
case_study.architecture: React → R3F (scene graph) → Three.js (WebGL) → GSAP (transitions). Adaptive pacing engine monitors interaction frequency.
case_study.result: Prototype demonstrates 3x engagement time vs equivalent 2D content in A/B tests.
